StructureDepthFaultLinesResultRow.description:
Represents the columns of a row in a structure depth fault lines export.

These fields are the current agreed upon standard result. Changes to the fields or
their validation should cause the version defined in the standard result schema to
increase the version number in a way that corresponds to the schema versioning
specification (i.e. they are a patch, minor, or major change).

NAME.description: Index column. The name of the fault this row represents. Required.
NAME.title: Name

POLY_ID.description: Index column. The id of the polygon which this row represents. Required.
POLY_ID.title: Poly Id

X_UTME.description: The X coordinate this row represents. Required.
X_UTME.title: X Utme

Y_UTMN.description: The Y coordinate this row represents. Required.
Y_UTMN.title: Y Utmn

Z_TVDSS.description: The Z coordinate (depth) this row represents. Required.
Z_TVDSS.title: Z Tvdss

StructureDepthFaultLinesResultRow.title: StructureDepthFaultLinesResultRow

description:
Represents the resultant structure depth fault lines parquet file, which is
naturally a list of rows.

Consumers who retrieve this parquet file must read it into a json-dictionary
equivalent format to validate it against the schema.
title: StructureDepthFaultLinesResult
